connections.why: Choosing a legal entity is a first decision for any business

Marketing planning operationalises the marketing role

Pricing in the mix depends on the firm's cost structure

Break-even informs whether an investment will be viable
Employees are a key stakeholder managed through HRM
Product decisions must be deliverable by operations

Employee relations affect motivation and morale
Gearing extends profitability and liquidity ratio analysis
Budgets formalise and control expected cash flows
Sales forecasts feed quantitative marketing plans
International marketing is central to operating as an MNC
Lean methods refine the chosen production process
Production planning schedules the operations method
Crises threaten stakeholders and demand contingency plans
R&D creates the new products marketed through the mix
Information systems supply the data behind market research
